name: A Lesson to Learn
summary: Mathrengyl Bearwalker sends young druids from Darnassus to Moonglade to learn the ways of water. There, they meet an elder of the Cenarion Circle and begin training in their aquatic aspect.

sections.title: The Call of the Wild
sections.body: Mathrengyl Bearwalker guides young night elf druids as they practice among Darnassus’s boughs. When an initiate shows a firm bond with nature and readiness for greater responsibility, Mathrengyl sends them toward mastery of the waters. Cenarius’s gifts demand focus, and learning to cross the depths without drowning calls for guidance from the Cenarion Circle’s elders.

sections.title: Journey to Nighthaven
sections.body: The initiate leaves Darnassus for Moonglade, an ancient sanctuary beneath Mount Hyjal. In Nighthaven, Dendrite Starblaze waits as an elder mentor of the Cenarion Circle. Starblaze judges whether young shapeshifters are ready for the trials that lead to aquatic form. Mastering water takes both physical resilience and mental resolve.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
aliases: who gives a lesson to learn
faq.answer: Mathrengyl Bearwalker, a druid trainer in Darnassus’s Cenarion Enclave, sends you once your early druidic training has advanced enough.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: This begins a druid’s path toward aquatic form. You travel to Moonglade for instruction and trials from the elder Dendrite Starblaze.
Dendrite Starblaze lives in Nighthaven, on the northern shores of Lake Elune'ara in Moonglade.

faq.q: How do druids reach Moonglade for this quest?
faq.answer: Druids can use Teleport: Moonglade to travel directly to the sacred grove, guided by their spiritual attunement.

faq.q: What comes after speaking to Dendrite Starblaze?
faq.answer: After you speak with Dendrite Starblaze, he sends you to the Trial of the Lake, where your endurance and clarity beneath the water will be tested.

angles.text: As a druid, this marks a milestone in your training and opens the way to commune with Cenarius's gifts beneath the waves.
As a kaldorei of Darnassus, answering the Cenarion Circle’s call in Moonglade honors tradition and connects you with your ancient teachers.
